description: Modal side panel showing page metadata - created and last-edited user and date, computed word count and reading time, and an optional analytics view count.

parameters.name: Blocks
parameters.description: Currently loaded page blocks. When absent, the component loads them from the block provider.

parameters.name: Page
parameters.description: The page whose metadata should be displayed.

parameters.name: LayoutMode
parameters.description: Forced layout. Mobile presents the panel as a sheet.
